output: {"pmid":"21821710","title":"FERM domain mutations induce gain of function in JAK3 in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.","journal":"Blood","year":2011,"cited_by":72,"is_review":false,"matched":[],"abstract":"Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma (ATLL) is an incurable disease where most patients succumb within the first year of diagnosis.
